verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions for registering, transferring, renewing and managing domains, plus an MCP server for availability checks. No evidence shows an API endpoint or feed that returns current registration, renewal or transfer prices per TLD. Reseller price-setting flexibility is a related feature, not a machine-readable price list, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, pricing is machine-readable — an API or feed returns current registration/renewal/transfer prices per TLD so tooling can compare and budget
